title: FLA import: layer names decoded as raw binary instead of strings
description:
After loading Magnet.fla, several layer names in the timeline contain raw binary bytes instead of readable text.

## Observed
Layer names such as: "\x01\x00\x00\x06\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00ÿÿÿ?ÿÿ"
Visible in the timeline UI as garbled characters (e.g. 'yyy?yy').
Affects layers across multiple scenes (AA scene layer-149, Scene 5 layer-156, BA scene layer-160, AB scene layer-163, BB scene layer-167).

## Expected
Layer names should be decoded as human-readable strings from the FLA CPicLayer stream.
